authentication.meaning: Existing user instruction authorizes the conditional deletion; this is a missing credential capability, not a request to approve the task again.

credential_signature_scan.scope_limit: Pattern scan is a supplementary check; backups contain only existing public GitHub repository data, not local personal document corpora or credential stores.

backups.git_mirrors_and_bundles: Parent agent supplies/verifies them separately; source refs and release asset metadata are retained here.

pre_deletion_gates: New repository contains both independent skill directories with matching names and complete requirements/licenses/tests.
Both original Git histories are reachable; preserve colliding v0.1.0 tags under distinct namespaces without rewriting original objects.
Backups include full mirror/bundles, all four Release assets and metadata, five CI log ZIPs and seven build artifact ZIPs; verify an independent restore and portable backup checksum.
Each merged Skill passes official validation and Plugin Eval above 90; combined native and real first-to-second pipeline tests pass.
New repository and installable release are public and downloadable; switch active links/install sources and preserve historical provenance/link mapping.
Immediately before deletion recheck exact owner/repository IDs and unchanged remote refs; delete only the two explicit old repositories, never the original Karpathy repository.
Deletion credential must have delete_repo; if missing, finish reviewable migration then handle authentication, leaving old repositories untouched until the capability is granted.
Verify both old repository endpoints are gone and record the final new repository URL, release, backup digest and deletion outcomes.
